strings.en: There’s nothing I can’t smash! I am the{NEWLINE}Pokéathlon Destruction King!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 即便这里有一面墙！{NEWLINE}我也要击破它穿越！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Even if there’s a wall in my way,{NEWLINE}I’ll smash right through it!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 不断地破坏⋯⋯{NEWLINE}即便对方是座山。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Keep on smashing...{NEWLINE}even if it’s a mountain.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 看着飞来的飞碟{NEWLINE}身体不自觉地就去捕捉！{SCROLL}
strings.en: My body just automatically catches any{NEWLINE}Discs that come my way!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 捕捉口袋竞技的明天,{NEWLINE}专为捕捉飞碟而来！{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ve come to catch Discs and catch the{NEWLINE}Pokéathlon!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你抓到的飞碟{NEWLINE}是一种叫未来的希望之星！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Disc you caught is tomorrow’s{NEWLINE}shooting star!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 来吧,让我接住它！{NEWLINE}不管什么飞碟我都能接住！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Bring it on. I’ll catch it! I’ll catch{NEWLINE}any Disc that comes my way!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 这跳跃简直就像风一样！{NEWLINE}这身影简直就像云一样！！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The jump was like the wind!{NEWLINE}The form was like a cloud!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 飞吧！向着高高的天空！{NEWLINE}这身影简直是无重力！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Jump high to the sky!{NEWLINE}The form is weightless!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 阅读空气的流向,{NEWLINE}支配天空的口袋竞技员。{SCROLL}
strings.en: A Pokéathlete that can read the{NEWLINE}flow of the wind and control the air.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 在我眼里没有天空与{NEWLINE}地面的交界存在！！{SCROLL}
strings.en: There’s no border between the ground{NEWLINE}and the sky within me!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 谁都不能让我停下来了！{NEWLINE}我是专为奔跑而生的！{SCROLL}
strings.en: There’s no one who can stop me!{NEWLINE}I was born to run!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 体力还没见到底！{NEWLINE}能跑整整一天！{SCROLL}
strings.en: My stamina hasn’t even hit bottom!{NEWLINE}I can run all day long!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 一旦动起来就停不下来！{NEWLINE}口袋竞技的永动机！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Once I start moving, I can’t stop!{NEWLINE}The Pokéathlon’s perpetual motion!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我的引擎是冠军！{NEWLINE}我的马达是胜利！{SCROLL}
strings.en: My engine is the championship,{NEWLINE}and my motor is victory!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 毫无破绽的架势！{NEWLINE}击落所有的精灵！{SCROLL}
strings.en: A stance without a single opening!{NEWLINE}Knock down every last Pokémon!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 被逼到绝境后就完了！{NEWLINE}连续击落至最后一只！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Get cornered and it’s all over!{NEWLINE}Knock them down, one after another!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 制霸赛场！真为跟你站在{NEWLINE}同一个场地的人感到悲哀！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Ruler of the Ring! I pity anyone who{NEWLINE}has to stand in the same Ring as you!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你到底是谁！{NEWLINE}赛场会告诉你！{SCROLL}
strings.en: What exactly are you anyway?{NEWLINE}That’s what the Ring will tell you!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 扔雪球的话天下第一！{NEWLINE}用你的精准追逐冠军吧。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The world’s best at throwing Snow!{NEWLINE}Chase the championship with that aim!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我们扔的雪球{NEWLINE}就是冠军的结晶！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Snowballs we throw are{NEWLINE}crystals of championship!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 简直就是机枪！{NEWLINE}这雪球是子弹吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: It’s like a machine gun!{NEWLINE}Are those Snowballs bullets?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 不知道会从哪儿飞来！{NEWLINE}雪球看起来就像有分身一样！{SCROLL}
strings.en: I don’t know where it will leap from{NEWLINE}next! The Snowballs seem to split!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 这球谁都停不下来！{NEWLINE}绝对不会打偏！{SCROLL}
strings.en: No one can stop this ball! It will hit{NEWLINE}any Goal I aim for!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 用这精彩的团队合作{NEWLINE}进球吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Use that wonderful teamwork and make{NEWLINE}the Goal!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 矫健的身姿！{NEWLINE}胜利的一击！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Such graceful form!{NEWLINE}A winning shot!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 和球一起生活！{NEWLINE}生活在球里面！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Live with the ball.{NEWLINE}Live inside the ball!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 把分数送给它！{NEWLINE}身体力行公平竞赛精神吧。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Give the points as a gift to them. It’s{NEWLINE}the embodiment of fair play.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 失误也要有笑容！{NEWLINE}胜利并不是口袋竞技的全部！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Smile even when you miss! The{NEWLINE}Pokéathlon isn’t just about winning!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 即便是自己的球门{NEWLINE}也要果断地射门！{SCROLL}
strings.en: You don’t hesitate to aim for your{NEWLINE}own Goal!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 没什么破坏团结的！{NEWLINE}乌龙球是友情的证明！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Nothing can break our unity! An own{NEWLINE}Goal is proof of our friendship!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 为什么要搞这么显眼？{NEWLINE}因为胜利不是口袋竞技的全部。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Why do you stand out like that? Winning{NEWLINE}is not the only thing in the Pokéathlon.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 出现了！大家的人气！{NEWLINE}签名就等拿到冠军之后吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Here it is! What you’ve all been waiting{NEWLINE}for! Autographs after the competition!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 要想看我胜利的话{NEWLINE}就给你看吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: If you want to see me win, I’ll show you{NEWLINE}just how I win!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我这么努力仅仅是因为{NEWLINE}胜利会带给大家欢乐！{SCROLL}
strings.en: When I do my best and win, I make{NEWLINE}everyone happy!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0205}比赛规则
strings.en: {VAR:0205}Event Rules

strings.zh: 朝着重点飞吧！奔跑吧！
strings.en: Aim for the Goal and jump! Run!

strings.zh: 奔跑着收集旗子吧！
strings.en: Run, collect Pennants, and return!

strings.zh: 弄进位置里去！
strings.en: Get in the Circle!

strings.zh: 不断敲碎石板！
strings.en: Break lots of Blocks!

strings.zh: 抓住飞来的飞碟！
strings.en: Catch the flying Discs!

strings.zh: 朝着亮着的灯跳吧！
strings.en: Jump and aim for the lit Lamps!

strings.zh: 叫唤精灵奔跑吧！跑起来！
strings.en: Run a Relay with Pokémon! Run!

strings.zh: 将对手击出环内！
strings.en: Push your rivals out of the Ring!

strings.zh: 不断扔雪球吧！
strings.en: Throw lots of Snowballs!

strings.zh: 将球射进对方球门吧！
strings.en: Get the ball in an opponent’s Goal!

strings.zh: {VAR:0205}操作方法
strings.en: {VAR:0205}Controls

strings.zh: 触摸精灵跳跃！{NEWLINE}同时操作３只！{NEWLINE}像那谁一样跨栏吧！
strings.en: Touch the Pokémon to jump!{NEWLINE}Control three Pokémon at the{NEWLINE}same time. Jump the Hurdles!

strings.zh: 跨栏是以最快速度{NEWLINE}冲过终点的游戏。{NEWLINE}用跳跃跨过栏,{NEWLINE}以最快为目标冲刺。{NEWLINE}由３只的合计时间{NEWLINE}决定所得分数。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}速度：奔跑速度{NEWLINE}跳跃：跳跃的高度
strings.en: In Hurdle Dash, you race against time to{NEWLINE}the finish line. Jump over the Hurdles{NEWLINE}and be first to finish. Points are given{NEWLINE}based on how many seconds it took all{NEWLINE}three Pokémon to reach the finish line.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Speed: Running Speed{NEWLINE}Jump: Jump Height

strings.zh: 触摸精灵跳！{NEWLINE}用跳来跨过栏！{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}同时操作３只精灵,{NEWLINE}比所有人都快地冲过终点吧！
strings.en: Touch the Pokémon to jump!{NEWLINE}Jump to clear the Hurdles!{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Control three Pokémon at the same{NEWLINE}time and finish before{NEWLINE}everyone else!

strings.zh: 滑动精灵移动！{NEWLINE}从后面撞上去{NEWLINE}就能抢到对方的旗！
strings.en: Slide the stylus over a{NEWLINE}Pokémon to move it! Hit others{NEWLINE}from behind to take Pennants!

strings.zh: 抢旗是用３只精灵{NEWLINE}交互进行抢旗,最后比{NEWLINE}旗子数量的比赛。{NEWLINE}旗子最多能抢到９面。{NEWLINE}从后面撞上去{NEWLINE}就能抢到对方的旗。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}速度：奔跑速度{NEWLINE}技术：行动的灵巧度
strings.en: In Pennant Capture, your three Pokémon{NEWLINE}run in turns to bring back Pennants.{NEWLINE}Up to nine Pennants can be held at{NEWLINE}one time. Strike your opponents from{NEWLINE}behind to steal their Pennants.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Skill: Ease of Movement{NEWLINE}Speed: Running Speed

strings.zh: 快速滑动精灵{NEWLINE}进行移动！{NEWLINE}越滑速度{NEWLINE}就越快！{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}争取在最短时间内{NEWLINE}抢到比所有人{NEWLINE}都要多的旗子吧！
strings.en: Slide your Pokémon quickly{NEWLINE}to move it!{NEWLINE}The more you slide, the faster{NEWLINE}it goes!{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Grab more Pennants than anyone{NEWLINE}else in the shortest time!

strings.zh: 移动精灵吧！{NEWLINE}同时操作３只精灵！
strings.en: Use the stylus to move your{NEWLINE}Pokémon around! Control{NEWLINE}three Pokémon at once!

strings.zh: 抢位置{NEWLINE}是与对手互推的比赛。{NEWLINE}在环的计时器跑完{NEWLINE}１圈的时候弄进{NEWLINE}位置内就得分。{NEWLINE}位置的数字就是分数。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}力量：推的力量{NEWLINE}耐力：耐疲劳度
strings.en: Circle Push is an event where you push{NEWLINE}your opponent. If you are inside a Circle{NEWLINE}after the timer has counted down,{NEWLINE}you are awarded points. The number{NEWLINE}written in the Circle is the number of{NEWLINE}points you will receive.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Power: Push Power{NEWLINE}Stamina: Ability to Keep Pushing

strings.zh: 用笔画着{NEWLINE}移动！{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}同时操作３只精灵,{NEWLINE}进入位置内{NEWLINE}拿高分吧！
strings.en: Use the stylus to move your{NEWLINE}Pokémon around!{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Control three Pokémon at once and{NEWLINE}aim for the Circle with the{NEWLINE}most points!

strings.zh: 点击石板撞击！{NEWLINE}按下交换键{NEWLINE}就切换到下一个精灵！
strings.en: Touch the Blocks to strike!{NEWLINE}Touch the Switch button to{NEWLINE}switch to the next Pokémon!

strings.zh: 劈石板就是{NEWLINE}纯粹的破坏石板的比赛。{NEWLINE}精灵要是累了{NEWLINE}就换吧。{NEWLINE}每破坏一个石板{NEWLINE}都会有分数。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}力量：破坏力{NEWLINE}耐力：耐疲劳度
strings.en: Block Smash is simply an event where you{NEWLINE}smash Blocks. Switch out your Pokémon{NEWLINE}as each becomes tired. You receive{NEWLINE}points according to how many Blocks{NEWLINE}you smash.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Power: Destructive Power{NEWLINE}Stamina: Ability to Keep Going

strings.zh: 点击石板撞击！{NEWLINE}连打石板{NEWLINE}击碎更多的石板吧！{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}按下交换键{NEWLINE}就能切换到{NEWLINE}下一只精灵！
strings.en: Touch the Blocks to smash them!{NEWLINE}Tap the Blocks rapidly to smash{NEWLINE}as many as you can!{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Touch the Switch button to switch{NEWLINE}to the next Pokémon!

strings.zh: １）拿笔画精灵进行移动！{NEWLINE}　　同时操作３只！{NEWLINE}２）用触摸进行跳接！
strings.en: 1) Use the stylus to move{NEWLINE}three Pokémon around.{NEWLINE}2) Touch to jump and catch!

strings.zh: 抢飞碟是同时{NEWLINE}操作３只精灵{NEWLINE}跳着接住从大海飞来的{NEWLINE}飞碟的比赛。{NEWLINE}飞碟越在游戏后期{NEWLINE}抓住分数越高。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}跳跃：跳的高度{NEWLINE}力量：推的力量
strings.en: Disc Catch is an event where you control{NEWLINE}your three Pokémon at the same time and{NEWLINE}jump to catch Discs that come flying{NEWLINE}from the sea. The later in the event{NEWLINE}you catch a Disc, the more points{NEWLINE}you get.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Jump: Jump Height{NEWLINE}Power: Push Power

strings.zh: １）操作精灵进行移动！{NEWLINE}　　同时操作３只精灵！{NEWLINE}　　控制他们向{NEWLINE}　　飞碟下面移动吧！{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}２）点下精灵{NEWLINE}　　就能跳起来！{NEWLINE}　　不断地抓住{NEWLINE}　　飞碟吧！
strings.en: 1) Use the stylus to move your Pokémon{NEWLINE}around. Control three Pokémon at once.{NEWLINE}Move them underneath the Discs!{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}2) Touch your Pokémon lightly to{NEWLINE}jump! Catch as many Discs{NEWLINE}as you can!

strings.zh: 控制３只精灵{NEWLINE}迅速拉下面{NEWLINE}跳起来！
strings.en: Quickly pull the three Pokémon{NEWLINE}down to jump!

strings.zh: 蹦床是同时{NEWLINE}操作３只精灵,{NEWLINE}跳起来碰到{NEWLINE}亮着的灯的比赛。{NEWLINE}用尽所有的跳跃{NEWLINE}多碰灯多拿分数吧。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}跳跃：跳跃高度{NEWLINE}技术：横向跳跃轻易度
strings.en: In Lamp Jump, you control your three{NEWLINE}Pokémon as they try to jump and touch{NEWLINE}the Lamps as they light. Try to touch as{NEWLINE}many Lamps as you can in one jump.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Jump: Jump Height{NEWLINE}Skill: Ability to Jump Sideways

strings.zh: 迅速拉３只精灵的{NEWLINE}下面进行跳跃！{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}拉歪的时候{NEWLINE}能进行横向跳跃！
strings.en: Quickly pull the three Pokémon down and{NEWLINE}watch them jump!{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Pull them diagonally to have them{NEWLINE}jump to the side!

strings.zh: 快速滑动进行奔跑！{NEWLINE}越滑速度越快！{NEWLINE}累了的话就交换吧！
strings.en: Quickly flick to dash! Flick as{NEWLINE}fast as you can to go faster!{NEWLINE}Switch when you’re tired!

strings.zh: 赛跑是{NEWLINE}不断交换精灵看看能{NEWLINE}跑多少距离的比赛。{NEWLINE}累了的话就交换吧。{NEWLINE}凭奔跑的距离{NEWLINE}换算成分数。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}耐力：耐疲劳度{NEWLINE}速度：奔跑速度
strings.en: Relay Run is an event where you move from{NEWLINE}Pokémon to Pokémon, trying to run{NEWLINE}as far as you can. Switch your Pokémon{NEWLINE}when they’re tired. Points will be{NEWLINE}awarded based only on the distance run.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Stamina: Endurance{NEWLINE}Speed: Running Speed

strings.zh: 快速滑动精灵向{NEWLINE}右边奔跑！{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}滑的越多{NEWLINE}精灵就越快！{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}按下交换键{NEWLINE}就能切换到{NEWLINE}下一只精灵！
strings.en: Quickly flick the stylus to the right to{NEWLINE}get your Pokémon to dash!{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}The more you flick to the right, the{NEWLINE}faster your Pokémon will go!{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Touch the Switch button to{NEWLINE}switch to the next Pokémon!

strings.zh: １）描着精灵移动{NEWLINE}２）快速滑动是撞！{NEWLINE}３）轻轻点一下是跳！
strings.en: 1) Use the stylus to move.{NEWLINE}2) Quickly flick to tackle!{NEWLINE}3) Lightly touch to jump!

strings.zh: 撞人{NEWLINE}是让对方掉下去的比赛。{NEWLINE}从环上让对方掉下去{NEWLINE}就得分。{NEWLINE}在增加一边按下交换键{NEWLINE}就能进行交换。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}耐力：不易弹开度{NEWLINE}力量：撞的力度
strings.en: Ring Drop is an event where you push{NEWLINE}your opponent. You get points each time{NEWLINE}you push your opponent out of the Ring.{NEWLINE}If you push the Switch button in your{NEWLINE}corner, you can switch Pokémon.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Stamina: Ability to Resist Pushing{NEWLINE}Power: Tackle Strength

strings.zh: １）用笔描着精灵{NEWLINE}　　进行移动！{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}２）快速滑动触控笔{NEWLINE}　　就能朝着那方向撞！{NEWLINE}　　撞飞对手吧！{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}３）轻轻点击精灵{NEWLINE}　　就是跳压！{NEWLINE}　　压住对手吧！
strings.en: 1) Use the stylus to move your Pokémon!{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}2) Quickly flick the stylus to tackle!{NEWLINE}Blow your opponent away!{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}3) Lightly touch your{NEWLINE}Pokémon to get them to jump!{NEWLINE}Your Pokémon can stomp on others!

strings.zh: １）快速在上面滑动{NEWLINE}　　就能扔雪球！{NEWLINE}２）触摸雪球就会变大！
strings.en: 1) Quickly flick upward on{NEWLINE}your Pokémon to throw Snow!{NEWLINE}2) Touch to hoard more Snow!

strings.zh: 扔雪球是同时{NEWLINE}操作３只精灵向对方{NEWLINE}扔雪球,最后看谁扔中的{NEWLINE}最多的比赛。{NEWLINE}打中对方队伍的{NEWLINE}任何精灵都能得分。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}技术：扔的精度{NEWLINE}力量   ：雪球的力量
strings.en: In Snow Throw, you control three of your{NEWLINE}Pokémon at the same time and hit your{NEWLINE}opponents with Snowballs. You’ll receive{NEWLINE}points no matter who you hit on your{NEWLINE}opponent’s team.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Skill: Throwing Accuracy{NEWLINE}Power: Snowball Strength

strings.zh: １）快速在上面滑动精灵{NEWLINE}　　扔出雪球吧！{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}２）在拿着雪球的时候{NEWLINE}　　触摸精灵{NEWLINE}　　雪球就会变大！{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}　　用大雪球砸中{NEWLINE}　　对方会晕过去！
strings.en: 1) Flick upward on your Pokémon to{NEWLINE}throw a Snowball!{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}2) When holding a Snowball, touch the{NEWLINE}Pokémon to make the Snowball bigger!{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Bigger Snowballs can make your{NEWLINE}opponent faint on impact!

strings.zh: １）同时操作３只！{NEWLINE}　　描着精灵移动。{NEWLINE}２）快速滑动奔跑。！
strings.en: 1) Control three Pokémon! Use{NEWLINE}the stylus to move around!{NEWLINE}2) Flick quickly to dash!

strings.zh: 足球是将球{NEWLINE}踢进对方球门的比赛。{NEWLINE}只要是对方球门,{NEWLINE}不管是怎么样的进球都能得分。{NEWLINE}自己的球门被攻破{NEWLINE}就扣分。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}技术：射门的长度{NEWLINE}力量：射门的力度
strings.en: In Goal Roll, you try to get the ball into{NEWLINE}your opponent’s Goal. It doesn’t matter{NEWLINE}which of their Goals--you’ll earn points.{NEWLINE}But if the ball ends up in your own Goal,{NEWLINE}you’ll lose points.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Skill: Rolling Length{NEWLINE}Power: Rolling Strength

strings.zh: １）同时操作３只！{NEWLINE}　　用触控笔描着精灵{NEWLINE}　　进行移动！{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}２）快速滑动笔{NEWLINE}　　朝着该方向奔跑！{NEWLINE}　　冲刺起来{NEWLINE}　　就会射门！
strings.en: 1) Control three Pokémon at once. Use{NEWLINE}the stylus to move your Pokémon!{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}2) Flick quickly with the stylus to{NEWLINE}dash! If you’re dashing, then{NEWLINE}you can shoot for the Goal!
